vorratskammer.webp.prompt:
Flat children's book illustration for a learning app for 6- to 8-year-olds, Montessori calm.
Soft pastel colours, gentle daylight, no harsh shadows, simple shapes, soft dark-violet outlines (#3B2A6B), 
matte paper texture, no gradients except a soft sky. Calm and friendly, bright, nothing scary, no darkness.
Wide landscape format. Keep the centre of the image quiet and low in detail (light grass or ground), because the
app places its own learning material and text over the middle. Interesting details only near the edges.
Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos or signs anywhere in the image. No people, no faces, no animals
unless the scene description asks for them.

Scene: The back wall of a bright, tidy storeroom (pantry) of a school kitchen, seen straight on, no people. The wall meets the floor at about three quarters of the image height, with a thin light baseboard; the lowest quarter is a plain light wooden floor with nothing standing on it. A small window on the left side of the wall, starting about one fifth below the top edge, with soft daylight, a pale sky and one potted herb on the sill. Along the far right edge tall light-wood shelves standing on the floor, with plain jars, tins, paper bags and woven baskets, all without any labels or writing. Nothing else on the wall or on the floor: the left lower part and the middle stay plain warm cream wall and empty floor. Colours: warm cream, light wood, soft blue-grey, a little soft green.
vorratskammer.webp.quelle: erzeugt mit werkzeuge/bilder/erzeugen.mjs (Azure OpenAI), umgewandelt aus PNG mit cwebp -q 82
vorratskammer.webp.bildart: Szenenbild (Stimmungsebene, grundsaetze-bilder §11 A1): Hintergrund der Welt Vorrat und Packungen im Spiel (Wand, Fenster, Boden; das Ding der Reihe steht auf der Fensterbank) und in der Einführung
vorratskammer.webp.geprueft: kein Text, keine Ziffern, keine Menschen und Tiere (A3, A6); Mitte ruhig; Gläser und Tüten ohne Schrift; Boden frei
